@graph.dcterms:title: Test data of 745 LCO-graphite pouch cells in three tab designs
@graph.schema:description: Test data of 745 LCO-graphite pouch cells from three manufacturers, each in end-tab, mid-tab and multi-tab variants, with a five-cycle reference capacity test at 25 °C for every cell and a 1000-cycle ageing test at 1C and 35 °C for 27 of them. The 772 files in the Battery Data Format (CSV) are the processed data of the Microsoft folder of the Battery Data Alliance datastore (https://github.com/battery-data-alliance/bdf-datastore) at commit 754304f, unchanged, with their metadata as a BattINFO deposit graph. Source permalink: https://github.com/battery-data-alliance/bdf-datastore/tree/754304f6191b06a78a762636f211e98fcf3dc305/Microsoft.
